memoryRule: a complete three-stop path severs one parent relation, gives a second branch a non-local wrong parent and copied notch, lets a third branch remember the route, and opens a remote orphan gap; later paths inherit the altered topology
interactionRule: pointer/touch or digits 1–9 choose three distinct witnesses; partial paths remain geometry-neutral; the third choice, Enter, Space, or the path control commits; Delete lifts latest; R/Escape releases
representationRupture: native-WebGL witness orbit, continuous SVG pressure slab, and Canvas false-join picture -> semantic DOM tree with actual parent edges and irregular branch witnesses
encounterRupture: paired dwell, sustained pressure, and cross-seam drag -> three-stop path selection with a topological threshold
temporalRupture: reciprocal counterfeit, material load, and false spatial join -> bounded wrong-parent memory that changes the graph's inheritance relation
mediumRupture: p5.js WEBGL, inline SVG, and Canvas 2D -> browser-native semantic DOM plus CSS clip-path geometry
changedRule: A closed path teaches the tree a non-local parent relation rather than leaving a local mark.
visibleConsequence: Actual branch edges, node roles, parent pointers, copied notch geometry, and a remote orphan gap change after a valid path; the first two selections remain geometry-neutral.
falsifier: Delete if a single choice commits, if the false parent is only UI, if the remote gap is cosmetic, if later paths restart from baseline, or if lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v032 if the blind field reads as a generic node diagram or interface instead of a singular childlike inheritance organism.
promotion: candidate / held pending browser matrices, interaction evidence, independent caption-free perceptual review, production readback, and provider revision linkage
